WITH album_rates AS (
  SELECT
    AlbumId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
    AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
all_album_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_rate
  FROM album_rates
)
SELECT
  album_rates.AlbumId,
  album_rates.average_unit_price,
  album_rates.average_bytes_per_millisecond,
  album_rates.average_bytes_per_millisecond - all_album_average.average_rate AS difference_from_all_album_average
FROM album_rates
CROSS JOIN all_album_average
ORDER BY difference_from_all_album_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
